scenes.title: System becomes stronger by admitting limits

Kimi builds drift detection into the permanent pipeline. Lane formalizes the conditions under which the claim can be reinstated. David uses the admitted limit to make a cautious, defensible call. The AI's transparency—showing the boundary of what it knows—becomes the most trusted part of the system.
